info.title: virtu API
info.description: SimpleLogin-compatible email alias API. Authenticate with the `Authentication: <api_key>` header (SimpleLogin's exact header name — not Authorization). Errors use the {"error": "..."} envelope.

recommendation.description: Present when ?hostname= is given and the user already created an alias for that hostname (latest one wins).

post.description: Register a new account. MVP deviation: the account is activated immediately (no activation email is sent yet — TODO email verification).
Authenticate and obtain an api_key for the Authentication header. MFA is not implemented: mfa_enabled is always false and mfa_key null.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's information. Also serves as api-key validation.

Get user aliases, paginated (20 per page). Filters pinned/disabled/enabled are presence-based and exclusive. The POST variant additionally accepts a JSON body with a `query` search string (some frameworks cannot send GET bodies).

post.description: Get user aliases, paginated (20 per page). Filters pinned/disabled/enabled are presence-based and exclusive. The POST variant additionally accepts a JSON body with a `query` search string (some frameworks cannot send GET bodies).

get.description: Get alias info (same shape as the /v2/aliases items).

put.description: Update alias fields. `mailbox_ids` replaces the alias's mailbox set (all ids must be your verified mailboxes; the lowest id becomes the primary). `disable_pgp` is accepted but ignored (PGP is not implemented).

patch.description: Update alias fields. `mailbox_ids` replaces the alias's mailbox set (all ids must be your verified mailboxes; the lowest id becomes the primary). `disable_pgp` is accepted but ignored (PGP is not implemented).

delete.description: Delete an alias. The address is tombstoned and never reusable.

post.description: Enable/disable an alias; returns the new status.

get.description: Get alias activities (email log entries), paginated (20 per page).
Options for creating a new alias: available (signed) suffixes, whether the user can create one, and a prefix suggestion derived from ?hostname=.

post.description: Create a new custom alias from a prefix and a signed suffix obtained from GET /v5/alias/options. The first mailbox_ids entry becomes the primary mailbox; the rest become extra delivery mailboxes. ?hostname= is recorded and drives the options `recommendation`.
Create a new random alias on the user's default alias domain. ?mode=uuid|word overrides the user's alias_generator setting. ?hostname= is recorded and drives the options `recommendation`.

get.description: Get contacts (reverse aliases) for an alias, paginated (20 per page).

post.description: Create a contact for an alias; a reverse alias is minted for it. Accepts a bare address or a full mailbox ("First Last <first@example.com>"). Returns 201, or 200 with existed=true when the contact was already added.
Block/unblock forwarding from a contact; returns the new state.

get.description: Get the user's mailboxes, including unverified ones.

post.description: Create a new mailbox. MVP deviation: created verified=true (no verification email is sent yet).

put.description: Update a mailbox. Only `default` is supported; `email` change returns 400 (not implemented yet) and `cancel_email_change` is a no-op.

delete.description: Delete a mailbox. Its aliases are deleted (and tombstoned) unless transfer_aliases_to names another of your verified mailboxes (-1 = delete).

get.description: Aggregate counts: aliases, forwards, replies, blocks.

patch.description: Update user settings (SimpleLogin error strings on invalid values). `random_alias_default_domain` must be a usable domain: one of the alias domains or one of your verified custom domains.

get.description: Domains usable for random aliases: the built-in alias domains plus the user's verified custom domains.

patch.description: Enter sudo mode by re-entering the account password. Sudo lasts 5 minutes on the presented api key and gates POST /api_key.

post.description: Create a new API key. Requires sudo mode (PATCH /sudo first); responds 440 {"error": "Need sudo"} otherwise.

get.description: Log out: revokes the presented API key (deviation — SimpleLogin only clears its web-session cookie; we have no cookie sessions).
